newsitem.title: CHINA: Earthquake jolts China's Yellow Sea.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake jolts China's Yellow Sea.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.1 on the open-ended Richter scale jolted China's south Yellow Sea on Monday, shaking residents of eastern coastal regions, the Xinhua news agency said.
The earthquake struck at 2.31 a.m. (1831 GMT Sunday), Xinhua said.
Residents of eastern Jiangsu province were shaken by the earthquake, it said, but there were no reports of casualties or damage.

The State Seismological Bureau said it had forecast an earthquake measuring five to six degrees on the Richter scale might hit the eastern coastal area and the southern section of the Yellow Sea, Xinhua said.
